items.quote: They delivered their share of an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations reliably.
They drove the transformation of the operating model for the whole division.
They managed bilateral negotiations on the water agreement for their unit.
They headed the division's budget planning, setting priorities for several teams.
They drove the crisis response to a major system outage for the whole division.
They spearheaded the redesign of the citizen journey for permits at the national level.
Quivi headed the partnership with sister agencies on youth services, setting priorities for several teams.
